description: This file defines the Android ListFragment 'WiFiDirectServicesList' that displays a list of available Wi-Fi Direct services. It includes an internal adapter class to render each service and handles user interactions with the list items, allowing connection initiation to selected services.

classes.name: WiFiDirectServicesList
classes.description: A ListFragment subclass that displays available Wi-Fi Direct services, allowing user interaction to connect to a selected service.

classes.name: WiFiDevicesAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter that renders WiFiP2pService objects in the list, showing device name, instance, and status.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the list fragment.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter and sets it for the ListFragment.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on list items; initiates connection via callback.

methods.name: WiFiDevicesAdapter.getView
methods.description: Creates or updates the list item view to display service details.

methods.name: getDeviceStatus
methods.description: Converts Wi-Fi P2P device status codes into human-readable strings.
